$comment: Product definition (spec §부록 B) — single source for scripts/gen-frames.mjs (mock API, fallback geometry) and scripts/blender/frame_builder.py (GLB modelling). One frame: the PoC fits this frame and nothing else. Dimensions in mm, glTF axes (+Y up, +Z toward camera, origin = nose-pad contact plane). The lens plane sits lens_plane_mm in front of the origin; the rim front is 1 mm proud of the lens plane. `build` holds modelling parameters; scripts/lib/frame-defs.mjs derives assets.anchor (hinges, pad contact, rim back/outline, lens back) from them.
